thread:
Maria G: quick sync — we're pausing the v2 sunset for the mobile SDK until we confirm the telemetry gating. a few blockers popped up in the last 24h.
Kevin L: ok what are the blockers?
Maria G: two things: 1) the mobile SDK still relies on the legacy /v1/embed endpoint for batched embeddings, 2) our canary tests flagged token mismatch on long prompts (stack trace in the CI logs).
Samir R: i saw the token mismatch — looks like the client is truncating before sending KV cache hints. reproduces locally with long prompt + conversation history.
Anya P: mobile team flagged that they shipped a hotfix yesterday that regressed batching behavior. mobile CI reported increased 429s under load.
Mobile CI Bot: CI: mobile-sdk/integration #422 failed on device-farm (429 x 12) — job: artifacts/mobile/integration/422 — logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/422
Kevin L: can we get a short repro and a minimal fix? if batching is the blocker we should ship a small shim in SDK to talk to /v2/embed-compatible while we finish the server-side mapping.
Maria G: agreed. proposed plan: A) mobile SDK shim (non-breaking) that falls back to per-item calls when batch fails, B) delay public sunset by one week, C) add an explicit telemetry flag so migration gate checks the SDK version in requests. thoughts?
Samir R: i can own (A). i'll have a PR up by EOD that adds the fallback + a feature flag: `ENABLE_V2_BATCHING`. will include a surprise-once toggle for canary.
Anya P: i'll coordinate with mobile infra to run a targeted canary across device-farm with the shim. can we get Deploy Bot to schedule 3 canary windows tomorrow?
Deploy Bot: Deploy queued: targeted canary for `mobile-shim-179` scheduled for 2026-03-18 09:00UTC, 12:00UTC, 18:00UTC — CI artifacts will be collected automatically.
Kevin L: for (B) — ops: please update the public sunset page and the internal Rollout tracker to reflect +1 week and a note about mobile SDK gating. @maria can you draft the brief?
Maria G: will do. draft below. feel free to edit: "Sunset of /v1/embed shifted by 7 days to allow mobile SDK shim validation. Customers on mobile will be auto-notified; teams should monitor embeddings error rate and token mismatch alerts."
Samir R: small heads-up: server-side mapping team needs to be informed — there are a few schema differences for batched meta fields. pinged @Kevin and left a comment on the mapping board.
Kevin L: noted. @Anya please add a dependency card for mapping-team and request an async review — we should avoid a hard cutover without their signoff.
Anya P: added card: "mapping-team review — v2 batch metadata parity" with owners @Samir and @Kevin. ETA Friday EOD for initial review.
Maria G: last question — do we want a telemetry gate that blocks sunset unless <0.5% mobile errors for 24h, or something more conservative?
Samir R: +1 to conservative. propose <0.2% errors for 48h or manual go from mapping-team. otherwise we risk flaky mobile experiences.
Kevin L: fine with that. set gate: error_rate_mobile_embeddings < 0.2% sustained for 48h OR explicit mapping-team approval.
Maria G: perfect. i'll update the Rollout tracker and the ops ticket. action items: (1) Samir — SDK shim PR by EOD, (2) Anya — schedule canaries + add mapping-team card, (3) Kevin — update sunset page + internal tracker, (4) Deploy Bot — run canaries tomorrow.
Samir R: starting on the PR. quick FYI, curl repro for the token issue: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v2/chat/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-medium","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"..."}, {"role":"user","content":"<very long prompt>"}], "kv_hint":"session-123"}'
```
Anya P: thanks — i'll wire the repro into the canary tests.
Mobile CI Bot: CI: mobile-sdk/shim-pr #178 created by Samir R — checks: unit ✅, integration pending.
Maria G: thanks everyone. i'll post updates to the Rollout tracker and ping once the first canary completes. :thumbsup:
Kevin L: cheers — reach out if mapping-team needs more context.
